documents.title: Borrower reply – EFT clarification
paragraphs: Thank you for the quick reply. I meant the escrow refund: I'd like the $486.27 surplus from my escrow statement deposited into my checking account instead of getting a paper check. My monthly payment can stay the way I pay it now.
What do you need from me to set that up?
